text: Could you make me a looping video wallpaper for my phone with soft blue and purple glowing ribbons moving slowly against a dark background? I’ve been wanting to freshen up my phone because I look at it so often throughout the day. I mean an 8-second video in vertical 9:16, with a slow flowing motion rather than anything abrupt. Please generate it from scratch, not from a photo, and leave the top third mostly dark with most of the ribbons below it so the clock stays readable. I worry a little about wallpapers making my screen feel cluttered. There should be no words, clock graphic, or sound, since my phone supplies the clock, and the repeat should be seamless with no jump when it loops.
